Browser sessions no longer close a tab after its request is completed. The tab returns to the pool as ready, and the next request reuses it, reapplying its own timeouts, extra headers, and resource/domain routes (after `unroute_all`) so nothing leaks between requests. Tabs that hit an error or got closed by the browser are closed and evicted, and the internal response listener is detached after every request so reused tabs don't stack handlers.

Adds `close_pages()` to all browser sessions to close every open tab; the next request opens a fresh one. `PagePool` gains `get_ready_page`/`remove_page`/`clear` and `PageInfo.mark_ready`, new pages start busy, and the unused `cleanup_error_pages` is removed.

Proxy-rotation contexts keep closing per request. <p dir="auto">Scrapling is an adaptive Web Scraping framework that handles everything from a single request to a full-scale crawl.</p>
<p dir="auto">Its parser learns from website changes and automatically relocates your elements when pages update. Its fetchers bypass anti-bot systems like Cloudflare Turnstile out of the box. And its spider framework lets you scale up to concurrent, multi-session crawls with pause/resume, automatic proxy rotation, and a crawl speed that adapts to how fast each website responds and backs off when it starts blocking you - all in a few lines of Python. One library, zero compromises.</p>
<p dir="auto">Blazing fast crawls with real-time stats and streaming. Built by Web Scrapers for Web Scrapers and regular users, there's something for everyone.</p>

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Spiders - A Full Crawling Framework</h3><a id="user-content-spiders---a-full-crawling-framework" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Spiders - A Full Crawling Framework" href="#spiders---a-full-crawling-framework"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>🕷️ <strong>Scrapy-like Spider API</strong>: Define spiders with <code>start_urls</code>, async <code>parse</code> callbacks, and <code>Request</code>/<code>Response</code> objects.</li>
<li>⚡ <strong>Concurrent Crawling</strong>: Configurable concurrency limits, per-domain throttling, and download delays.</li>
<li>🔄 <strong>Multi-Session Support</strong>: Unified interface for HTTP requests, and stealthy headless browsers in a single spider - route requests to different sessions by ID.</li>
<li>💾 <strong>Pause & Resume</strong>: Checkpoint-based crawl persistence. Press Ctrl+C for a graceful shutdown; restart to resume from where you left off.</li>
<li>📡 <strong>Streaming Mode</strong>: Stream scraped items as they arrive via <code>async for item in spider.stream()</code> with real-time stats - ideal for UI, pipelines, and long-running crawls.</li>
<li>🛡️ <strong>Blocked Request Detection</strong>: Automatic detection and retry of blocked requests with customizable logic.</li>
<li>🚦 <strong>AutoThrottle</strong>: Stop guessing delays. The spider tunes the delay of each domain on its own from how fast the website responds, then doubles it (or waits what <code>Retry-After</code> asks) whenever the website starts blocking or rate-limiting you, and speeds back up once it stops.</li>
<li>🤖 <strong>Robots.txt Compliance</strong>: Optional <code>robots_txt_obey</code> flag that respects <code>Disallow</code>, <code>Crawl-delay</code>, and <code>Request-rate</code> directives with per-domain caching.</li>
<li>🧪 <strong>Development Mode</strong>: Cache responses to disk on the first run and replay them on subsequent runs - iterate on your <code>parse()</code> logic without re-hitting the target servers.</li>
<li>🧩 <strong>Ready-made Spider Templates</strong>: Skip the boilerplate with <code>CrawlSpider</code> for rule-based link following, <code>SitemapSpider</code> for sitemap/robots.txt-driven crawls, <code>XMLFeedSpider</code>/<code>CSVFeedSpider</code> for iterating XML/RSS and CSV feeds, and <code>ShopifySpider</code> to pull every product out of any Shopify store through its JSON API, one item per variant.</li>
<li>🔗 <strong>Link Extraction</strong>: A standalone <code>LinkExtractor</code> primitive with allow/deny patterns, domain filters, CSS/XPath scoping, extension filtering, and canonicalization - use it inside the templates or on its own.</li>
<li>📦 <strong>Built-in Export</strong>: Export results through hooks and your own pipeline or the built-in JSON/JSONL/CSV/XML exporters with <code>result.items.to_json()</code>, <code>to_jsonl()</code>, <code>to_csv()</code>, and <code>to_xml()</code>.</li>
</ul>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Advanced Websites Fetching with Session Support</h3><a id="user-content-advanced-websites-fetching-with-session-support" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Advanced Websites Fetching with Session Support" href="#advanced-websites-fetching-with-session-support"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li><strong>HTTP Requests</strong>: Fast and stealthy HTTP requests with the <code>Fetcher</code> class. Can impersonate browsers' TLS fingerprint, headers, and use HTTP/3.</li>
<li><strong>Dynamic Loading</strong>: Fetch dynamic websites with full browser automation through the <code>DynamicFetcher</code> class supporting Playwright's Chromium and Google's Chrome.</li>
<li><strong>Anti-bot Bypass</strong>: Advanced stealth capabilities with <code>StealthyFetcher</code> and fingerprint spoofing. Can easily bypass all types of Cloudflare's Turnstile/Interstitial with automation.</li>
<li><strong>Session Management</strong>: Persistent session support with <code>FetcherSession</code>, <code>StealthySession</code>, and <code>DynamicSession</code> classes for cookie and state management across requests.</li>
<li><strong>Proxy Rotation</strong>: Built-in <code>ProxyRotator</code> with cyclic or custom rotation strategies across all session types, plus per-request proxy overrides.</li>
<li><strong>Domain & Ad Blocking</strong>: Block requests to specific domains (and their subdomains) or enable built-in ad blocking (~3,500 known ad/tracker domains) in browser-based fetchers.</li>
<li><strong>DNS Leak Prevention</strong>: Optional DNS-over-HTTPS support to route DNS queries through Cloudflare's DoH, preventing DNS leaks when using proxies.</li>
<li><strong>Remote Browsers</strong>: Instead of launching a browser locally, connect to one that's already running through CDP with <code>cdp_url</code>, whether it's on the same machine, another host, or a managed browser provider. You can also point any browser fetcher at your own Chromium build with <code>executable_path</code>.</li>
<li><strong>Background API Capture</strong>: Pass a URL pattern to <code>capture_xhr</code>, and all matching XHR/fetch responses the page makes while loading are collected for you as <code>Response</code> objects in <code>response.captured_xhr</code> - grab a site's API data without reverse-engineering the requests yourself.</li>
<li><strong>Async Support</strong>: Complete async support across all fetchers and dedicated async session classes.</li>
</ul>

<span class="pl-en">print</span>(<span class="pl-s">f"Scraped <span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-kos">{</span><span class="pl-en">len</span>(<span class="pl-s1">result</span>.<span class="pl-c1">items</span>)<span class="pl-kos">}</span></span> quotes"</span>)

class QuotesSpider(Spider):
    name = "quotes"
    start_urls = ["https://quotes.toscrape.com/"]
    concurrent_requests = 10
    
    async def parse(self, response: Response):
        for quote in response.css('.quote'):
            yield {
                "text": quote.css('.text::text').get(),
                "author": quote.css('.author::text').get(),
            }
            
        next_page = response.css('.next a')
        if next_page:
            yield response.follow(next_page[0].attrib['href'])

result = QuotesSpider().start()
print(f"Scraped {len(result.items)} quotes")
result.items.to_json("quotes.json")" tabindex="0" role="button">

from scrapling.fetchers import FetcherSession, AsyncStealthySession

class MultiSessionSpider(Spider):
    name = "multi"
    start_urls = ["https://example.com/"]
    
    def configure_sessions(self, manager):
        manager.add("fast", FetcherSession(impersonate="chrome"))
        manager.add("stealth", AsyncStealthySession(headless=True), lazy=True)
    
    async def parse(self, response: Response):
        for link in response.css('a::attr(href)').getall():
            # Route protected pages through the stealth session
            if "protected" in link:
                yield Request(link, sid="stealth")
            else:
                yield Request(link, sid="fast", callback=self.parse)  # explicit callback" tabindex="0" role="button">

<div class="highlight highlight-source-python notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto"><pre><span class="pl-k">import</span> <span class="pl-s1">asyncio</span>
<span class="pl-k">from</span> <span class="pl-s1">scrapling</span>.<span class="pl-s1">fetchers</span> <span class="pl-k">import</span> <span class="pl-v">FetcherSession</span>, <span class="pl-v">AsyncStealthySession</span>, <span class="pl-v">AsyncDynamicSession</span>

<span class="pl-k">async</span> <span class="pl-k">with</span> <span class="pl-en">FetcherSession</span>(<span class="pl-s1">http3</span><span class="pl-c1">=</span><span class="pl-c1">True</span>) <span class="pl-k">as</span> <span class="pl-s1">session</span>:  <span class="pl-c"># `FetcherSession` is context-aware and can work in both sync/async patterns</span>
    <span class="pl-s1">page1</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-s1">session</span>.<span class="pl-c1">get</span>(<span class="pl-s">'https://quotes.toscrape.com/'</span>)
    <span class="pl-s1">page2</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-s1">session</span>.<span class="pl-c1">get</span>(<span class="pl-s">'https://quotes.toscrape.com/'</span>, <span class="pl-s1">impersonate</span><span class="pl-c1">=</span><span class="pl-s">'firefox135'</span>)

<span class="pl-c"># Async session usage</span>
<span class="pl-k">async</span> <span class="pl-k">with</span> <span class="pl-en">AsyncStealthySession</span>(<span class="pl-s1">max_pages</span><span class="pl-c1">=</span><span class="pl-c1">2</span>) <span class="pl-k">as</span> <span class="pl-s1">session</span>:
    <span class="pl-s1">tasks</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> []
    <span class="pl-s1">urls</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> [<span class="pl-s">'https://example.com/page1'</span>, <span class="pl-s">'https://example.com/page2'</span>]
    
    <span class="pl-k">for</span> <span class="pl-s1">url</span> <span class="pl-c1">in</span> <span class="pl-s1">urls</span>:
        <span class="pl-s1">task</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-s1">session</span>.<span class="pl-c1">fetch</span>(<span class="pl-s1">url</span>)
        <span class="pl-s1">tasks</span>.<span class="pl-c1">append</span>(<span class="pl-s1">task</span>)

<p dir="auto">Extract pages to a file directly without programming (Extracts the content inside the <code>body</code> tag by default).
